        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \nconst loadSources = async \n\n  };\n\n  // 检查历史记录（用于决定显示哪个视图）\n  const checkHistoryRecords = async (autoSwitchView: boolean = true) =&gt; {\n    if (!projectId) return;\n    setCheckingHistory(true);\n    try {\n      // 获取项目的所有来源信息\n      const response = await api.get('/source-information', {\n        params: {\n          pageType: &#96;project-${projectId}&#96;,\n          page: 1,\n          pageSize: 1000\n        }\n      });\n      if (response.data.success &amp;&amp; response.data.data) {\n        // 过滤出历史记录（AI问答、技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿）\n        const historyCategories = ['ai-qa-summary', 'tech-package-qa', 'tech-strategy-qa', 'tech-article-qa', 'technical-translation'];\n        const filtered = response.data.data.filter((source: SourceInformation) =&gt; {\n          // 从 metadata 中解析 category\n          let category: string | undefined;\n          if (source.metadata) {\n            if (typeof source.metadata === 'string') {\n              try {\n                const parsed = JSON.parse(source.metadata);\n                category = parsed.category || parsed.sourceCategory;\n              } catch (e) {\n                // 忽略解析错误\n              }\n            } else if (typeof source.metadata === 'object') {\n              category = source.metadata.category || source.metadata.sourceCategory;\n            }\n          }\n          // 也检查直接设置的 category\n          if (source.category) {\n            category = source.category;\n          }\n          return category &amp;&amp; historyCategories.includes(category);\n        });\n        setHistoryRecords(filtered);\n        // 只有在 autoSwitchView 为 true 时才自动切换视图\n        // 这样可以避免在AI共创过程中保存对话后强制跳回历史记录页面\n        if (autoSwitchView) {\n          // 如果有历史记录，显示历史记录视图；否则显示AI共创视图\n          setShowHistoryView(filtered.length &gt; 0);\n        }\n      } else {\n        if (autoSwitchView) {\n          setShowHistoryView(false);\n        }\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \nconst saveTechnicalTranslationAsSource = async \n', saveResult.error);\n        return null;\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('[ProjectResources] 保存技术转译内容失败:', error);\n      return null;\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 处理跳转到技术策略或技术包装页面\n  const handleNavigateToAIPage = async (pageType: 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-package') =&gt; {\n    // 收集所有需要保存的来源 ID\n    const sourceIds: string[] = [];\n    \n    // 1. 总结并保存对话内容\n    const conversationSourceId = await summarizeAndSaveConversation(pageType);\n    if (conversationSourceId) {\n      sourceIds.push(conversationSourceId);\n    }\n    \n    // 2. 保存技术转译内容\n    const translationSourceId = await saveTechnicalTranslationAsSource(pageType);\n    if (translationSourceId) {\n      sourceIds.push(translationSourceId);\n    }\n    \n    // 构建跳转 URL\n    let url = &#96;/${pageType}&#96;;\n    const params = new URLSearchParams();\n    \n    if (projectId) {\n      params.append('projectId', projectId);\n      // 添加 newConversation 参数，确保创建新对话\n      params.append('newConversation', 'true');\n    }\n    \n    // 添加所有 sourceId（支持多个）\n    sourceIds.forEach(sourceId =&gt; {\n      params.append('sourceId', sourceId);\n    });\n    \n    if (params.toString()) {\n      url += &#96;?${params.toString()}&#96;;\n    }\n\n    // 跳转\n    navigate(url);\n  };\n\n  if (loading || checkingHistory) {\n    return (\n      &lt;div className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50 flex items-center justify-center\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-blue-600\"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    );\n  }\n\n  if (!project) {\n    return (\n      &lt;div className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50 flex items-center justify-center\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"text-gray-500\"&gt;项目不存在&lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    );\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50\"&gt;\n;",

                  "lineNumber": 21904,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \\n() =&amp;gt; {\\n\\n    \\n    const internetInfo = sources.filter(s =&amp;gt; {\\n      // 排除上传的文件（URL是文件路径的）\\n      const hasUrl = s.url &amp;amp;&amp;amp; typeof s.url === 'string' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; s.url.trim().length &amp;gt; 0;\\n      if (!hasUrl) {\\n        // 没有URL的文本来源，需要检查是否是对话摘要或技术转译\\n        const category = getCategory(s);\\n        if (category === 'ai-qa-summary' || category === 'technical-translation') {\\n          return false; // 排除对话摘要和技术转译\\n        }\\n        return true; // 没有URL且不是对话摘要/技术转译的，归类为互联网信息\\n      }\\n      \\n      const urlStr = s.url.trim();\\n      const isHttpUrl = urlStr.startsWith('http://') || urlStr.startsWith('https://');\\n      const isFileUrl = !isHttpUrl &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n        urlStr.startsWith('/uploads/') || \\n        urlStr.startsWith('uploads/') ||\\n        /\\\\.(pdf|doc|docx|txt|md|jpg|jpeg|png|gif|webp|ppt|pptx)$/i.test(urlStr)\\n      );\\n      \\n      if (isFileUrl) {\\n        return false; // 排除文件\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 排除对话摘要和技术转译（这些应该显示在历史记录中，而不是互联网信息点）\\n      const category = getCategory(s);\\n      if (category === 'ai-qa-summary' || category === 'technical-translation') {\\n        return false; // 排除对话摘要和技术转译\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 包含http/https链接的来源，或者没有URL的文本来源（通过检索信息添加的）\\n      return true;\\n    });\\n    \\n    // 将公共知识库文件（type: 'knowledge_base'）转换为知识点格式\\n    const publicKnowledgeSources = sources.filter(s =&amp;gt; s.type === 'knowledge_base');\\n    const publicKnowledgeAsPoints: KnowledgePoint[] = publicKnowledgeSources.map(source =&amp;gt; ({\\n      id: source.id,\\n      tech_point_id: 0,\\n);\\n  }\\n;\","

{\\n    if (bytes &amp;lt; 1024) return bytes + ' B';\\n    if (bytes &amp;lt; 1024 * 1024) return (bytes / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' KB';\\n    return (bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1) + ' MB';\\n  };\\n\\n  const formatDate = (dateString?: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (!dateString) return '';\\n    const date = new Date(dateString);\\n    return date.toLocaleDateString('zh-CN', {\\n      year: 'numeric',\\n      month: 'long',\\n      day: 'numeric'\\n    });\\n  };\\n\\n  // 过滤检索信息：排除上传的文件，只显示真正的检索信息（http/https链接或文本来源）\\n  const filteredSources = sources.filter(source =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 排除上传的文件（URL是文件路径的，不是http链接）\\n    if (source.url &amp;amp;&amp;amp; !source.url.startsWith('http') &amp;amp;&amp;amp; !source.url.startsWith('https')) {\\n      return false;\\n    }\\n    // 只包含http/https链接或没有URL的文本来源\\n    return true;\\n  }).filter(source =&amp;gt;\\n    source.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||\\n    source.description?.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase())\\n  );\\n\\n  const filteredTechPoints = techPoints.filter(tp =&amp;gt;\\n    tp.name.toLowerCase().includes(techPointSearch.toLowerCase()) ||\\n    tp.description?.toLowerCase().includes(techPointSearch.toLowerCase())\\n  );\\n\\n  const filteredKnowledgePoints = knowledgePoints.filter(kp =&amp;gt;\\n    kp.title.toLowerCase().includes(knowledgeBaseSearch.toLowerCase()) ||\\n    kp.content?.toLowerCase().includes(knowledgeBaseSearch.toLowerCase())\\n  );\\n\\n  const filteredPublicFiles = publicKnowledgeFiles.filter(file =&amp;gt;\\n    file.name.toLowerCase().includes(publicFileSearch.toLowerCase()) ||\\n    file.description?.toLowerCase().includes(publicFileSearch.toLowerCase())\\n  );\\n\\n  const toggleTechPoint = (techPointId: number) =&amp;gt; {\\n    setSelectedTechPoints(prev =&amp;gt;\\n      prev.includes(techPointId)\\n        ? prev.filter(id =&amp;gt; id !== techPointId)\\n        : [...prev, techPointId]\\n    );\\n  };\\n\\n  const toggleKnowledgePoint = (knowledgePointId: number) =&amp;gt; {\\n    setSelectedKnowledgePoints(prev =&amp;gt;\\n      prev.includes(knowledgePointId)\\n        ? prev.filter(id =&amp;gt; id !== knowledgePointId)\\n        : [...prev, knowledgePointId]\\n    );\\n  };\\n\\n  const togglePublicFile = async (fileId: number) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (selectedPublicFiles.includes(fileId)) {\\n      setSelectedPublicFiles(prev =&amp;gt; prev.filter(id =&amp;gt; id !== fileId));\\n    } else {\\n      setSelectedPublicFiles(prev =&amp;gt; [...prev, fileId]);\\n      // 将选中的公共知识库文件添加到项目来源中\\n      if (projectId) {\\n        const file = publicKnowledgeFiles.find(f =&amp;gt; f.id === fileId);\\n        if (file) {\\n          try {\\n            await api.post('/source-information', {\\n              source_id: &amp;#96;public_kb_${file.id}&amp;#96;,\\n              title: file.name,\\n              type: 'knowledge_base',\\n              url: file.file_url || file.file_path,\\n              description: file.description || &amp;#96;公共知识库文件: ${file.name}&amp;#96;,\\n              page_type: &amp;#96;project-${projectId}&amp;#96;,\\n              conversation_id: null\\n            });\\n            // 重新加载来源列表\\n            await loadSources();\\n          } catch (error) {\\n            console.error('添加公共知识库文件到项目失败:', error);\\n          }\\n        }\\n      }\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleTechnicalTranslation = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    setIsTranslating(true);\\n    setTranslatedContent('');\\n    \\n    try {\\n      const contentParts: string[] = [];\\n      \\n      // 1. 拼接已选择的技术点\\n      if (configuredResources.techPoints.length &amp;gt; as any\\n          });\\n        } catch (error) {\\n          console.error('获取文件列表失败:', error);\\n        }\\n        \\n        for (const file of configuredResources.files) {\\n          contentParts.push(&amp;#96;### ${file.title}\\\\n\\\\n&amp;#96;);\\n          \\n          // 尝试从文件记录中获取markdown内容\\n          const fileRecord = fileRecords.find(f =&amp;gt; \\n            f.url === file.url || \\n            f.name === file.title ||\\n            f.id === file.source_id\\n          );\\n          \\n          if (fileRecord?.markdownContent) {\\n            // 使用文件的markdown内容\\n            contentParts.push(&amp;#96;${fileRecord.markdownContent}\\\\n\\\\n&amp;#96;);\\n          } else if (file.description) {\\n            // 如果没有markdown内容，使用description（可能已经包含markdown内容）\\n            contentParts.push(&amp;#96;${file.description}\\\\n\\\\n&amp;#96;);\\n          } else {\\n            contentParts.push(&amp;#96;文件：${file.title}\\\\n\\\\n&amp;#96;);\\n          }\\n        }\\n        contentParts.push('\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n');\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 3. 拼接已选择的知识点\\n      if (configuredResources.knowledgePoints.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        contentParts.push('## 已选择知识点\\\\n\\\\n');\\n        configuredResources.knowledgePoints.forEach((knowledgePoint, index) =&amp;gt; {\\n          contentParts.push(&amp;#96;### ${index + 1}. ${knowledgePoint.title}\\\\n\\\\n&amp;#96;);\\n          if (knowledgePoint.content) {\\n            contentParts.push(&amp;#96;${knowledgePoint.content}\\\\n\\\\n&amp;#96;);\\n          }\\n        });\\n        contentParts.push('\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n');\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 4. 拼接互联网信息点\\n      if (configuredResources.internetInfo.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        contentParts.push('## 互联网信息点\\\\n\\\\n');\\n        configuredResources.internetInfo.forEach((info, index) =&amp;gt; {\\n          contentParts.push(&amp;#96;### ${index + 1}. ${info.title}\\\\n\\\\n&amp;#96;);\\n          if (info.url) {\\n            contentParts.push(&amp;#96;链接：${info.url}\\\\n\\\\n&amp;#96;);\\n          }\\n          if (info.description) {\\n            contentParts.push(&amp;#96;${info.description}\\\\n\\\\n&amp;#96;);\\n          }\\n        });\\n      }\\n      \\n      const finalContent = contentParts.join('');\\n      setTranslatedContent(finalContent);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('技术转译失败:', error);\\n      alert('技术转译失败，请重试');\\n    } finally {\\n      setIsTranslating(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleSaveReview = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    setIsSaving(true);\\n    try {\\n      // 更新转译内容\\n      setTranslatedContent(reviewContent);\\n      // 这里可以添加保存到后端的逻辑\\n      // 例如：await api.post(&amp;#96;/projects/${projectId}/translated-content&amp;#96;, { content: reviewContent });\\n      \\n      setShowReviewModal(false);\\n      alert('内容已保存');\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('保存失败:', error);\\n      alert('保存失败，请重试');\\n    } finally {\\n      setIsSaving(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  // 总结对话内容并保存为来源信息\\n  const summarizeAndSaveConversation = async (targetPageType?: string, messages?: Array&amp;lt;{ id: string; content: string; sender: 'user' | 'ai'; timestamp: Date }&amp;gt;): Promise&amp;lt;string | null&amp;gt; =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 使用传入的消息列表，如果没有则使用状态中的消息\\n    const messagesToUse = messages || aiMessages;\\n    \\n    // 如果没有对话内容，直接返回 null\\n    if (messagesToUse.length === 0) {\\n      return null;\\n    }\\n\\n    // 如果没有指定pageType，使用project-{projectId}格式\\n    const pageType = targetPageType || (projectId ? &amp;#96;project-${projectId}&amp;#96; : undefined);\\n\\n    setIsSummarizingConversation(true);\\n    try {\\n      // 构建对话文本\\n      const conversationText = messagesToUse.map((msg) =&amp;gt; {\\n        const role = msg.sender === 'user' ? '用户' : 'AI助手';\\n        return &amp;#96;${role}: ${msg.content}&amp;#96;;\\n      }).join('\\\\n\\\\n');\\n\\n      // 如果对话文本太长，先截断（保留前2000字符）\\n      const maxLength = 2000;\\n      const truncatedText = conversationText.length &amp;gt; maxLength \\n        ? conversationText.substring(0, maxLength) + '\\\\n\\\\n...（内容已截断）'\\n        : conversationText;\\n\\n      // 生成总结（简化版本：使用对话内容作为描述，标题为总结）\\n      // 如果对话很长，取前100字符作为标题\\n      let summaryTitle = '项目资源对话摘要';\\n      let summaryDescription = truncatedText;\\n\\n      // 尝试使用 AI 生成更智能的总结\\n      try {\\n        const aiQAConfig = await configService.getDifyConfig('smart-workflow-ai-qa');\\n        const summaryPrompt = &amp;#96;请对以下对话进行总结，生成一个简洁的标题（不超过30字）和一段摘要（不超过300字）。用中文回答，格式为：\\n标题：[标题]\\n摘要：[摘要内容]\\n\\n对话内容：\\n${truncatedText}&amp;#96;;\\n\\n        const result = await workflowAPI.aiSearch(\\n          summaryPrompt,\\n          { context: [{ role: 'user', content: summaryPrompt }] },\\n          (aiQAConfig &amp;amp;&amp;amp; titleMatch[1]) {\\n            summaryTitle = titleMatch[1].trim();\\n          }\\n          if (summaryMatch &amp;amp;&amp;amp; summaryMatch[1]) {\\n            summaryDescription = summaryMatch[1].trim();\\n            // 如果 AI 生成的摘要太短，补充完整对话内容\\n            if (summaryDescription.length &amp;lt; 200) {\\n              summaryDescription = &amp;#96;${summaryDescription}\\\\n\\\\n完整对话内容：\\\\n${truncatedText}&amp;#96;;\\n            }\\n          }\\n        }\\n      } catch (error) {\\n        console.warn('使用 AI 生成总结失败，使用简化版本:', error);\\n        // 如果 AI 调用失败，使用简化版本\\n        summaryTitle = messagesToUse.length &amp;gt; 0 \\n          ? &amp;#96;项目对话摘要（${messagesToUse.length}条消息）&amp;#96;\\n          : '项目对话摘要';\\n      }\\n\\n      // 创建来源信息\\n      const sourceId = &amp;#96;project_conversation_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}&amp;#96;;\\n      const source: Source = {\\n        id: sourceId,\\n        title: summaryTitle,\\n        type: 'external',\\n        description: summaryDescription,\\n        category: 'ai-qa-summary', // AI问答总结信息\\n      };\\n\\n      // 保存到数据库\\n      const saveResult = await sourceService.saveSourceInformation(\\n        source,\\n        pageType,\\n        aiConversationId || undefined\\n      );\\n\\n      if (saveResult.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 如果没有转译内容，直接返回 null\\n    if (!translatedContent || translatedContent.trim().length === 0) {\\n      return null;\\n    }\\n\\n    try {\\n      // 生成标题（如果内容太长，截取前50字符）\\n      const maxTitleLength = 50;\\n      let title = '技术转译内容';\\n      \\n      // 尝试从转译内容中提取标题（第一行非空内容）\\n      const lines = translatedContent.split('\\\\n').filter(line =&amp;gt; saveResult.data) {\\n        console.log('[ProjectResources] 技术转译内容已保存:', {\\n          sourceId: saveResult.data.source_id,\\n          title: saveResult.data.title,\\n          pageType: targetPageType\\n        });\\n        return saveResult.data.source_id;\\n      } else {\\n        console.error('[ProjectResources] 保存技术转译内容失败:', saveResult.error);\\n        return null;\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('[ProjectResources] 保存技术转译内容失败:', error);\\n      return null;\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  // 处理跳转到技术策略或技术包装页面\\n  const handleNavigateToAIPage = async (pageType: 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-package') =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 收集所有需要保存的来源 ID\\n    const sourceIds: string[] = [];\\n    \\n    // 1. 总结并保存对话内容\\n    const conversationSourceId = await summarizeAndSaveConversation(pageType);\\n    if (conversationSourceId) {\\n      sourceIds.push(conversationSourceId);\\n    }\\n    \\n    // 2. 保存技术转译内容\\n    const translationSourceId = await saveTechnicalTranslationAsSource(pageType);\\n    if (translationSourceId) {\\n      sourceIds.push(translationSourceId);\\n    }\\n    \\n    // 构建跳转 URL\\n    let url = &amp;#96;/${pageType}&amp;#96;;\\n    const params = new URLSearchParams();\\n    \\n    if (projectId) {\\n      params.append('projectId', projectId);\\n      // 添加 newConversation 参数，确保创建新对话\\n      params.append('newConversation', 'true');\\n    }\\n    \\n    // 添加所有 sourceId（支持多个）\\n    sourceIds.forEach(sourceId =&amp;gt;                   "lineNumber": 7866,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \\n\\n\\n  // 自动保存对话摘要（使用指定的消息列表）\\n  const autoSaveConversationSummaryWithMessages = async (messages: Array&amp;lt;{ id: string; content: string; sender: 'user' | 'ai'; timestamp: Date }&amp;gt;) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (!projectId) return;\\n    \\n    // 检查是否有至少一轮完整的问答（至少一条用户消息和一条AI消息）\\n    const userMessages = messages.filter(msg =&amp;gt; msg.sender === 'user');\\n    const aiResponseMessages = messages.filter(msg =&amp;gt; msg.sender === 'ai');\\n    \\n    // 如果没有完整的对话，不保存\\n    if (userMessages.length === 0 || aiResponseMessages.length === 0) {\\n      return;\\n    }\\n\\n    // 如果有已保存的对话来源ID，先尝试删除旧的（如果存在）\\n    // 然后保存新的对话摘要\\n    try {\\n      // 如果已经有保存的对话，更新它；否则创建新的\\n      if (savedConversationSourceId) {\\n        // 尝试删除旧的来源记录（使用数据库ID）\\n        try {\\n          const idNumber = parseInt(savedConversationSourceId);\\n          if (!isNaN(idNumber)) {\\n            await api.delete(&amp;#96;/source-information/${idNumber}&amp;#96;);\\n          }\\n        } catch (error) {\\n          console.warn('删除旧对话记录失败:', error);\\n          // 如果删除失败，继续创建新的\\n        }\\n      }\\n\\n      // 保存新的对话摘要，使用 project-${projectId} 作为 pageType，传入消息列表\\n      const savedId = await summarizeAndSaveConversation(undefined, messages);\\n      \\n      if (savedId) {\\n        setSavedConversationSourceId(savedId);\\n        \\n        // 刷新历史记录\\n        await loadSources(); // 重新加载来源列表\\n        // 更新历史记录列表，但不自动切换视图（避免强制跳回历史记录页面）\\n        await checkHistoryRecords(false); // 传入 false 表示不自动切换视图\\n        \\n        console.log('[ProjectResources] 对话摘要已自动保存:', savedId);\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('[ProjectResources] 自动保存对话摘要失败:', error);\\n      // 不抛出错误，避免影响用户体验\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const loadPublicKnowledgeFiles = async () =&amp;gt;\\n;\\n;\","

【一句话说明（slogan）】\\n   - 【技术品牌定位与愿景】\\n   - 【用户体验与场景】\\n   如果信息不足，可以使用\\\"敬请期待\\\"作为占位符）\\n\\n输出要求：\\n- 只返回JSON格式，不要包含任何markdown代码块标记或其他文字说明\\n- JSON必须是有效的，可以直接用JSON.parse()解析\\n- 如果某些信息无法从对话中提取，使用合理的默认值或空值\\n- 所有数组字段必须是数组格式，即使为空也要使用[]\\n- technical_details必须是对象格式，即使为空也要使用{}\\n\\n示例JSON格式：\\n{\\n  \\\"name\\\": \\\"技术名称\\\",\\n  \\\"description\\\": \\\"技术描述\\\",\\n  \\\"tech_type\\\": \\\"feature\\\",\\n  \\\"priority\\\": \\\"medium\\\",\\n  \\\"technical_details\\\": {\\n    \\\"tech_principle\\\": \\\"技术原理说明\\\",\\n    \\\"tech_value\\\": \\\"技术价值说明\\\",\\n    \\\"tech_boundary\\\": \\\"技术边界说明\\\"\\n  },\\n  \\\"benefits\\\": [\\\"优势1\\\", \\\"优势2\\\", \\\"优势3\\\"],\\n  \\\"applications\\\": [\\\"场景1\\\", \\\"场景2\\\"],\\n  \\\"keywords\\\": [\\\"关键词1\\\", \\\"关键词2\\\", \\\"关键词3\\\"],\\n  \\\"features\\\": \\\"【一句话说明（slogan）】\\\\\\\\n说明内容\\\\\\\\n【技术品牌定位与愿景】\\\\\\\\n定位：定位说明\\\\\\\\n愿景：愿景说明\\\\\\\\n【用户体验与场景】\\\\\\\\n场景说明\\\"\\n}\\n\\n现在请分析对话内容并返回JSON：&amp;#96;;\\n\\n      // 调用AI进行提炼\\n      const aiQAConfig = await configService.getDifyConfig('smart-workflow-ai-qa');\\n      const result = await workflowAPI.aiSearch(\\n        extractPrompt,\\n        { context: [{ role: 'user', content: extractPrompt }] },\\n        (aiQAConfig &amp;amp;&amp;amp; aiQAConfig.enabled) ? aiQAConfig : undefined,\\n        undefined\\n      );\\n\\n      if (result.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; result.data) {\\n        const aiResponse = result.data.answer || result.data.result || '';\\n        \\n        // 尝试解析JSON（AI可能返回JSON或包含JSON的文本）\\n        let techPointData: any = null;\\n        try {\\n          // 尝试提取JSON部分（如果AI返回的是markdown代码块）\","

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \\n\\n\\n  // 自动保存对话摘要（使用指定的消息列表）\\n  const autoSaveConversationSummaryWithMessages = async (messages: Array&amp;lt;{ id: string; content: string; sender: 'user' | 'ai'; timestamp: Date }&amp;gt;) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (!projectId) return;\\n    \\n    // 检查是否有至少一轮完整的问答（至少一条用户消息和一条AI消息）\\n    const userMessages = messages.filter(msg =&amp;gt; msg.sender === 'user');\\n    const aiResponseMessages = messages.filter(msg =&amp;gt; msg.sender === 'ai');\\n    \\n    // 如果没有完整的对话，不保存\\n    if (userMessages.length === 0 || aiResponseMessages.length === 0) {\\n      return;\\n    }\\n\\n    // 如果有已保存的对话来源ID，先尝试删除旧的（如果存在）\\n    // 然后保存新的对话摘要\\n    try {\\n      // 如果已经有保存的对话，更新它；否则创建新的\\n      if (savedConversationSourceId) {\\n        // 尝试删除旧的来源记录（使用数据库ID）\\n        try {\\n          const idNumber = parseInt(savedConversationSourceId);\\n          if (!isNaN(idNumber)) {\\n            await api.delete(&amp;#96;/source-information/${idNumber}&amp;#96;);\\n          }\\n        } catch (error) {\\n          console.warn('删除旧对话记录失败:', error);\\n          // 如果删除失败，继续创建新的\\n        }\\n      }\\n\\n      // 保存新的对话摘要，使用 project-${projectId} 作为 pageType，传入消息列表\\n      const savedId = await summarizeAndSaveConversation(undefined, messages);\\n      \\n      if (savedId) {\\n        setSavedConversationSourceId(savedId);\\n        \\n        // 刷新历史记录\\n        await loadSources(); // 重新加载来源列表\\n        await checkHistoryRecords(); // 检查并更新历史记录视图\\n        \\n        console.log('[ProjectResources] 对话摘要已自动保存:', savedId);\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('[ProjectResources] 自动保存对话摘要失败:', error);\\n      // 不抛出错误，避免影响用户体验\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const loadPublicKnowledgeFiles = async () =&amp;gt;\\n;\\n;\","

0) {\\\\n        inputs.projectResources = resourceContext.join('\\\\\\\\n');\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      // 调用AI问答API\\\\n      const result = await workflowAPI.aiSearch(\\\\n        currentMessage,\\\\n        inputs,\\\\n        (aiQAConfig &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; aiQAConfig.enabled) ? aiQAConfig : undefined,\\\\n        aiConversationId || undefined\\\\n      );\\\\n\\\\n      let responseContent = '抱歉，我无法处理您的请求。';\\\\n\\\\n      if (result.success &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; {\\\\n        const updated = [...prev, aiMessage];\\\\n        // 在状态更新后，使用最新的消息列表自动保存\\\\n        setTimeout(async () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n          await autoSaveConversationSummaryWithMessages(updated);\\\\n        }, 300);\\\\n        return updated;\\\\n      });\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('AI问答API调用失败:', error);\\\\n      const errorMessage = {\\\\n        id: (Date.now() + 1).toString(),\\\\n        content: '抱歉，AI服务暂时不可用，请稍后重试。',\\\\n        sender: 'ai' as const,\\\\n        timestamp: new Date(),\\\\n      };\\\\n      setAiMessages((prev) =&amp;amp;gt; [...prev, errorMessage]);\\\\n    } finally {\\\\n      setAiLoading(false);\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  // 自动保存对话摘要（使用指定的消息列表）\\\\n  const autoSaveConversationSummaryWithMessages = async (messages: Array&amp;amp;lt;{ id: string; msg.sender === 'user');\\\\n    const aiResponseMessages = messages.filter(msg =&amp;amp;gt; msg.sender === 'ai');\\\\n    \\\\n    // 如果没有完整的对话，不保存\\\\n    if (userMessages.length === 0 || aiResponseMessages.length === 0) {\\\\n      return;\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 如果有已保存的对话来源ID，先尝试删除旧的（如果存在）\\\\n    // 然后保存新的对话摘要\\\\n    try {\\\\n      // 如果已经有保存的对话，更新它；否则创建新的\\\\n      if (savedConversationSourceId) {\\\\n        // 尝试删除旧的来源记录（使用数据库ID）\\\\n        try {\\\\n          const idNumber = parseInt(savedConversationSourceId);\\\\n          if (!isNaN(idNumber)) {\\\\n            await api.delete(&amp;amp;#96;/source-information/${idNumber}&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n          }\\\\n        } catch (error) {\\\\n          console.warn('删除旧对话记录失败:', error);\\\\n          // 如果删除失败，继续创建新的\\\\n        }\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      // 保存新的对话摘要，使用 project-${projectId} 作为 pageType，传入消息列表\\\\n      const savedId = await summarizeAndSaveConversation(undefined, messages);\\\\n      \\\\n      if (savedId) {\\\\n        setSavedConversationSourceId(savedId);\\\\n        \\\\n        // 刷新历史记录\\\\n        await loadSources(); {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.getFiles();\\\\n      if (response.success &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; response.data) {\\\\n        setPublicKnowledgeFiles(response.data);\\\\n      }\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('加载公共知识库文件失败:', error);\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  // 更新已配置的资源清单\\\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 区分文件来源和互联网信息点\\\\n    // 文件来源：通过文件上传功能上传的文件（URL是文件路径，不是http链接）\\\\n    // 互联网信息点：来自\\\\\\\"检索信息\\\\\\\"模块的来源（排除上传的文件，只包含http/https链接或没有URL的文本来源）\\\\n    const files = sources.filter(s =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      // 文件上传的通常URL是文件路径，不是http链接\\\\n      return s.type === 'external' &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; s.url &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; !s.url.startsWith('http') &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; !s.url.startsWith('https');\\\\n    });\\\\n    // 互联网信息点：排除上传的文件，只包含真正的互联网信息（http/https链接或文本来源）\\\\n    const internetInfo = sources.filter(s =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      // 排除上传的文件（URL是文件路径的）\\\\n      if (s.url &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; !s.url.startsWith('http') &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; !s.url.startsWith('https')) {\\\\n        return false;\\\\n      }\\\\n      // 包含http/https链接的来源，或者没有URL的文本来源（通过检索信息添加的）\\\\n      return true;\\\\n    });\\\\n    \\\\n    setConfiguredResources({\\\\n      files: files,\\\\n      internetInfo: internetInfo,\\\\n      techPoints: techPoints.filter(tp =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (!projectId) return;\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const response = await projectService.getProjectById(parseInt(projectId));\\\\n      if (response.success &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; response.data) {\\\\n        setProject(response.data);\\\\n      }\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('加载项目失败:', error);\\\\n    } finally {\\\\n      setLoading(false);\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  const loadSources = async () =&amp;amp;gt; '../types/project';\\nimport projectService from '../services/projectService';\\nimport { aiSearchService } from '../services/aiSearchService';\\nimport { techPointService } from '../types/publicKnowledge';\\nimport api from '../services/api';\\nimport { workflowAPI } from '../services/api';\\nimport { configService } from '../services/configService';\\nimport sourceService, { Source, SourceCategory } from '../services/sourceService';\\n\\ninterface SourceInformation {\\n  id: number;\\n  source_id: string;\\n  title: string;\\n  type: 'knowledge_base' | 'external';\\n  url?: string;\\n  description?: string;\\n  created_at: string;\\n  metadata?: any;\\n  category?: SourceCategory;\\n}\\n\\nconst ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = () =&amp;gt; {\\n  const { projectId } = useParams&amp;lt;{ projectId: string }&amp;gt;();\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const fileInputRef = useRef&amp;lt;HTMLInputElement&amp;gt;(null);\\n  const techPointSelectorRef = useRef&amp;lt;HTMLDivElement&amp;gt;(null);\\n  \\n  const [project, setProject] = useState&amp;lt;Project | null&amp;gt;(null);\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\n  const [sources, setSources] = useState&amp;lt;SourceInformation[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');\\n  const [selectedTechPoints, setSelectedTechPoints] = useState&amp;lt;number[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [selectedKnowledgePoints, setSelectedKnowledgePoints] = useState&amp;lt;number[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [techPoints, setTechPoints] = useState&amp;lt;TechPoint[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [knowledgePoints, setKnowledgePoints] = useState&amp;lt;KnowledgePoint[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [publicKnowledgeFiles, setPublicKnowledgeFiles] = useState&amp;lt;PublicKnowledgeFile[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [selectedPublicFiles, setSelectedPublicFiles] = useState&amp;lt;number[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [isUploading, setIsUploading] = useState(false);\\n  const [showTechPointSelector, setShowTechPointSelector] = useState(false);\\n  const [showKnowledgeBaseSelector, setShowKnowledgeBaseSelector] = useState(false);\\n  const [techPointSearch, setTechPointSearch] = useState('');\\n  const [knowledgeBaseSearch, setKnowledgeBaseSearch] = useState('');\\n  const [publicFileSearch, setPublicFileSearch] = useState('');\\n  const [configuredResources, setConfiguredResources] = useState&amp;lt;{\\n    files: SourceInformation[];\\n    internetInfo: SourceInformation[];\\n    techPoints: TechPoint[];\\n    knowledgePoints: KnowledgePoint[];\\n  }&amp;gt;({\\n    files: [],\\n    internetInfo: [],\\n    techPoints: [],\\n    knowledgePoints: []\\n  });\\n  const [isTranslating, setIsTranslating] = useState(false);\\n  const [translatedContent, setTranslatedContent] = useState&amp;lt;string&amp;gt;('');\\n  const [showReviewModal, setShowReviewModal] = useState(false);\\n  const [reviewContent, setReviewContent] = useState&amp;lt;string&amp;gt;('');\\n  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);\\n  const [showTechPointModal, setShowTechPointModal] = useState(false);\\n  const [showFileUploadModal, setShowFileUploadModal] = useState(false);\\n  const [showKnowledgePointModal, setShowKnowledgePointModal] = useState(false);\\n  const [showInternetInfoModal, setShowInternetInfoModal] = useState(false);\\n  const [isSummarizingConversation, setIsSummarizingConversation] = useState(false);\\n  const [showHistoryModal, setShowHistoryModal] = useState(false);\\n  const [historyRecords, setHistoryRecords] = useState&amp;lt;SourceInformation[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [historyLoading, setHistoryLoading] = useState(false);\\n  const [showHistoryView, setShowHistoryView] = useState(false); // 控制显示历史记录视图还是AI共创视图\\n  const [checkingHistory, setCheckingHistory] = useState(true); // 检查历史记录中\\n  const fileInputRefModal = useRef&amp;lt;HTMLInputElement&amp;gt;(null);\\n  \\n  // AI问答相关状态\\n  const [aiMessages, setAiMessages] = useState&amp;lt;Array&amp;lt;{ id: string; content: string; sender: 'user' | 'ai'; timestamp: Date }&amp;gt;&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [aiInputMessage, setAiInputMessage] = useState('');\\n  const [aiLoading, setAiLoading] = useState(false);\\n  const [aiConversationId, setAiConversationId] = useState&amp;lt;string | undefined&amp;gt;(undefined);\\n  const aiMessagesEndRef = useRef&amp;lt;HTMLDivElement&amp;gt;(null);\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (projectId) {\\n      loadProject();\\n      loadSources();\\n      loadTechPoints();\\n      loadPublicKnowledgeFiles();\\n      checkHistoryRecords(); // 检查历史记录\\n    }\\n  }, [projectId]);\\n\\n  // AI消息自动滚动到底部\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    aiMessagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });\\n  }, [aiMessages]);\\n\\n  // AI问答发送消息\\n  const handleAISendMessage = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (!aiInputMessage.trim() || aiLoading) return;\\n\\n    const userMessage = {\\n      id: Date.now().toString(),\\n      content: aiInputMessage.trim(),\\n      sender: 'user' as const,\\n      timestamp: new Date(),\\n    };\\n\\n    setAiMessages((prev) =&amp;gt; [...prev, userMessage]);\\n    const currentMessage = aiInputMessage.trim();\\n    setAiInputMessage('');\\n    setAiLoading(true);\\n\\n    try {\\n      // 获取智能工作流AI问答的Dify配置\\n      const aiQAConfig = await configService.getDifyConfig('smart-workflow-ai-qa');\\n\\n      // 构建上下文信息（包含项目资源）\\n      const contextMessages = aiMessages.map((msg) =&amp;gt; ({\\n        role: msg.sender === 'user' ? 'user' : 'assistant',\\n        content: msg.content,\\n      }));\\n\\n      // 添加项目资源信息到上下文\\n      const resourceContext: string[] = [];\\n      if (configuredResources.techPoints.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        resourceContext.push(&amp;#96;已选择的技术点：${configuredResources.techPoints.map(tp =&amp;gt; tp.name).join('、')}&amp;#96;);\\n      }\\n      if (configuredResources.files.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        resourceContext.push(&amp;#96;已上传的文件：${configuredResources.files.map(f =&amp;gt; f.title).join('、')}&amp;#96;);\\n      }\\n      if (configuredResources.knowledgePoints.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        resourceContext.push(&amp;#96;已选择的知识点：${configuredResources.knowledgePoints.map(kp =&amp;gt; kp.title).join('、')}&amp;#96;);\\n      }\\n\\n      const inputs: any = {\\n        context: contextMessages,\\n      };\\n\\n      if (resourceContext.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        inputs.projectResources = resourceContext.join('\\\\n');\\n      }\\n\\n      // 调用AI问答API\\n      const result = await workflowAPI.aiSearch(\\n        currentMessage,\\n        inputs,\\n        (aiQAConfig &amp;amp;&amp;amp; aiQAConfig.enabled) ? aiQAConfig : undefined,\\n        aiConversationId || undefined\\n      );\\n\\n      let responseContent = '抱歉，我无法处理您的请求。';\\n\\n      if (result.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; result.data) {\\n        responseContent = result.data.answer || result.data.result || responseContent;\\n        // 更新conversationId以支持多轮对话\\n        if (result.data.conversation_id) {\\n          setAiConversationId(result.data.conversation_id);\\n        }\\n      } else {\\n        responseContent = result.error || responseContent;\\n      }\\n\\n      const aiMessage = {\\n        id: (Date.now() + 1).toString(),\\n        content: responseContent,\\n        sender: 'ai' as const,\\n        timestamp: new Date(),\\n      };\\n\\n      setAiMessages((prev) =&amp;gt; [...prev, aiMessage]);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('AI问答API调用失败:', error);\\n      const errorMessage = {\\n        id: (Date.now() + 1).toString(),\\n        content: '抱歉，AI服务暂时不可用，请稍后重试。',\\n        sender: 'ai' as const,\\n        timestamp: new Date(),\\n      };\\n      setAiMessages((prev) =&amp;gt; [...prev, errorMessage]);\\n    } finally {\\n      setAiLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const loadPublicKnowledgeFiles = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.getFiles();\\n      if (response.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data) {\\n        setPublicKnowledgeFiles(response.data);\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('加载公共知识库文件失败:', error);\\n    }\\n  };\","

aiQAConfig : undefined,\\n          undefined\\n        );\\n\\n        if (result.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; result.data) {\\n          const aiResponse = result.data.answer || result.data.result || '';\\n          // 解析 AI 响应，提取标题和摘要\\n          const titleMatch = aiResponse.match(/标题[：:]\\\\s*(.+)/);\\n          const summaryMatch = aiResponse.match(/摘要[：:]\\\\s*(.+?)(?:\\\\n|$)/s);\\n          \\n          if (titleMatch &amp;amp;&amp;amp; titleMatch[1]) {\\n            summaryTitle = titleMatch[1].trim();\\n          }\\n          if (summaryMatch &amp;amp;&amp;amp; summaryMatch[1]) {\\n            summaryDescription = summaryMatch[1].trim();\\n            // 如果 AI 生成的摘要太短，补充完整对话内容\\n            if (summaryDescription.length &amp;lt; 200) {\\n              summaryDescription = &amp;#96;${summaryDescription}\\\\n\\\\n完整对话内容：\\\\n${truncatedText}&amp;#96;;\\n            }\\n          }\\n        }\\n      } catch (error) {\\n        console.warn('使用 AI 生成总结失败，使用简化版本:', error);\\n        // 如果 AI 调用失败，使用简化版本\\n        summaryTitle = messagesToUse.length &amp;gt; 0 \\n          ? &amp;#96;项目对话摘要（${messagesToUse.length}条消息）&amp;#96;\\n          : '项目对话摘要';\\n      }\\n\\n      // 创建来源信息\\n      const sourceId = &amp;#96;project_conversation_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}&amp;#96;;\\n      const source: Source = {\\n        id: sourceId,\\n        title: summaryTitle\\n      };\\n;\\n;\","

                  "lineNumber": 21475,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \\n\\n\\n  // 自动保存对话摘要（使用指定的消息列表）\\n  const autoSaveConversationSummaryWithMessages = async (messages: Array&amp;lt;{ id: string; content: string; sender: 'user' | 'ai'; timestamp: Date }&amp;gt;) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (!projectId) return;\\n    \\n    // 检查是否有至少一轮完整的问答（至少一条用户消息和一条AI消息）\\n    const userMessages = messages.filter(msg =&amp;gt; msg.sender === 'user');\\n    const aiResponseMessages = messages.filter(msg =&amp;gt; msg.sender === 'ai');\\n    \\n    // 如果没有完整的对话，不保存\\n    if (userMessages.length === 0 || aiResponseMessages.length === 0) {\\n      return;\\n    }\\n\\n    // 如果有已保存的对话来源ID，先尝试删除旧的（如果存在）\\n    // 然后保存新的对话摘要\\n    try {\\n      // 如果已经有保存的对话，更新它；否则创建新的\\n      if (savedConversationSourceId) {\\n        // 尝试删除旧的来源记录（使用数据库ID）\\n        try {\\n          const idNumber = parseInt(savedConversationSourceId);\\n          if (!isNaN(idNumber)) {\\n            await api.delete(&amp;#96;/source-information/${idNumber}&amp;#96;);\\n          }\\n        } catch (error) {\\n          console.warn('删除旧对话记录失败:', error);\\n          // 如果删除失败，继续创建新的\\n        }\\n      }\\n\\n      // 保存新的对话摘要，使用 project-${projectId} 作为 pageType，传入消息列表\\n      const savedId = await summarizeAndSaveConversation(undefined, messages);\\n      \\n      if (savedId) {\\n        setSavedConversationSourceId(savedId);\\n        \\n        // 刷新历史记录\\n        await loadSources(); // 重新加载来源列表\\n        // 更新历史记录列表，但不自动切换视图（避免强制跳回历史记录页面）\\n        await checkHistoryRecords(false); // 传入 false 表示不自动切换视图\\n        \\n        console.log('[ProjectResources] 对话摘要已自动保存:', savedId);\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('[ProjectResources] 自动保存对话摘要失败:', error);\\n      // 不抛出错误，避免影响用户体验\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const loadPublicKnowledgeFiles = async () =&amp;gt;\\n;\\n;\","

                  "lineNumber": 21732,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \\n\\n\\n  // 总结对话内容并保存为来源信息\\n  const summarizeAndSaveConversation = async (targetPageType?: string, messages?: Array&amp;lt;{ id: string; content: string; sender: 'user' | 'ai'; timestamp: Date }&amp;gt;): Promise&amp;lt;string | null&amp;gt; =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 使用传入的消息列表，如果没有则使用状态中的消息\\n    const messagesToUse = messages || aiMessages;\\n    \\n    // 如果没有对话内容，直接返回 null\\n    if (messagesToUse.length === 0) {\\n      return null;\\n    }\\n\\n    // 如果没有指定pageType，使用project-{projectId}格式\\n    const pageType = targetPageType || (projectId ? &amp;#96;project-${projectId}&amp;#96; : undefined);\\n\\n    setIsSummarizingConversation(true);\\n    try {\\n      // 构建对话文本\\n      const conversationText = messagesToUse.map((msg) =&amp;gt; {\\n        const role = msg.sender === 'user' ? '用户' : 'AI助手';\\n        return &amp;#96;${role}: ${msg.content}&amp;#96;;\\n      }).join('\\\\n\\\\n');\\n\\n      // 如果对话文本太长，先截断（保留前2000字符）\\n      const maxLength = 2000;\\n      const truncatedText = conversationText.length &amp;gt; maxLength \\n        ? conversationText.substring(0, maxLength) + '\\\\n\\\\n...（内容已截断）'\\n        : conversationText;\\n\\n      // 生成总结（简化版本：使用对话内容作为描述，标题为总结）\\n      // 如果对话很长，取前100字符作为标题\\n      let summaryTitle = '项目资源对话摘要';\\n      let summaryDescription = truncatedText;\\n\\n      // 尝试使用 AI 生成更智能的总结\\n;\\n;\","

                  "lineNumber": 22535,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \\n\\n\\n  // 保存技术转译内容为来源信息\\n  const saveTechnicalTranslationAsSource = async (targetPageType: 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-package'): Promise&amp;lt;string | null&amp;gt; =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 如果没有转译内容，直接返回 null\\n    if (!translatedContent || translatedContent.trim().length === 0) {\\n      return null;\\n    }\\n\\n    try {\\n      // 生成标题（如果内容太长，截取前50字符）\\n      const maxTitleLength = 50;\\n      let title = '技术转译内容';\\n      \\n      // 尝试从转译内容中提取标题（第一行非空内容）\\n      const lines = translatedContent.split('\\\\n').filter(line =&amp;gt; line.trim().length &amp;gt; 0);\\n      if (lines.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        const firstLine = lines[0].trim();\\n        // 移除 markdown 标题符号（##、###等）\\n        const cleanLine = firstLine.replace(/^#+\\\\s*/, '');\\n        if (cleanLine.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n          title = cleanLine.length &amp;gt; maxTitleLength \\n            ? cleanLine.substring(0, maxTitleLength) + '...'\\n            : cleanLine;\\n        }\\n      }\\n\\n      // 创建来源信息\\n      const sourceId = &amp;#96;project_translation_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}&amp;#96;;\\n      const source: Source = {\\n        id: sourceId,\\n        title: title,\\n        type: 'external',\\n        description: translatedContent,\\n        category: 'technical-translation', // 技术转译信息\\n      };\\n\\n      // 保存到数据库\\n      const saveResult = await sourceService.saveSourceInformation(\\n        source,\\n        targetPageType,\\n        aiConversationId || undefined\\n      );\\n\\n      if (saveResult.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; saveResult.data) {\\n        console.log('[ProjectResources] 技术转译内容已保存:', {\\n          sourceId: saveResult.data.source_id,\\n          title: saveResult.data.title,\\n          pageType: targetPageType\\n        });\\n        return saveResult.data.source_id;\\n      } else {\\n        console.error('[ProjectResources] 保存技术转译内容失败:', saveResult.error);\\n        return null;\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('[ProjectResources] 保存技术转译内容失败:\\n;\\n;\","

                  "lineNumber": 23051,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \\n\\n\\n  // 保存选中的 Web Search 结果为来源信息\\n  const handleSaveWebSearchResults = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (selectedSearchResults.size === 0) {\\n      alert('请至少选择一个搜索结果');\\n      return;\\n    }\\n\\n    if (!projectId) {\\n      alert('项目ID不存在');\\n      return;\\n    }\\n\\n    setIsAddingInternetInfo(true);\\n    try {\\n      const pageType = &amp;#96;project-${projectId}&amp;#96;;\\n      const selectedResults = Array.from(selectedSearchResults).map(index =&amp;gt; webSearchResults[index]);\\n      \\n      // 批量保存选中的搜索结果\\n      for (const result of selectedResults) {\\n        const sourceId = &amp;#96;web_search_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}&amp;#96;;\\n        const description = &amp;#96;${result.snippet || ''}\\\\n\\\\n${result.summary ? &amp;#96;摘要：${result.summary}&amp;#96; : ''}\\\\n\\\\n来源：${result.siteName || ''}&amp;#96;.trim();\\n        \\n        const source: Source = {\\n          id: sourceId,\\n          title: result.name || '未命名网页',\\n          type: 'external',\\n          url: result.url,\\n          description: description,\\n          category: 'web-search',\\n        };\\n\\n        await sourceService.saveSourceInformation(\\n          source,\\n          pageType,\\n          aiConversationId || undefined\\n        );\\n      }\\n\\n      // 刷新来源列表\\n      await loadSources();\\n      \\n      // 清空状态并关闭弹窗\\n      setWebSearchQuery('');\\n      setWebSearchResults([]);\\n      setSelectedSearchResults(new Set());\\n      setShowInternetInfoModal(false);\\n      \\n      alert(&amp;#96;成功添加 ${selectedResults.length} 个搜索结果&amp;#96;);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('[ProjectResources] 保存 Web Search 结果失败:', error);\\n      alert('保存失败，请重试');\\n    } finally {\\n      setIsAddingInternetInfo(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  // 保存技术转译内容为来源信息\\n;\","

                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"        \\\"contents\\\": \\\"const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \\\\n\\\\n\\\\n  // 总结对话内容并保存为来源信息\\\\n  const summarizeAndSaveConversation = async (targetPageType?: string, messages?: Array&amp;amp;lt;{ id: string; content: string; sender: 'user' | 'ai'; timestamp: Date }&amp;amp;gt;): Promise&amp;amp;lt;string | null&amp;amp;gt; =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 使用传入的消息列表，如果没有则使用状态中的消息\\\\n    const messagesToUse = messages || aiMessages;\\\\n    \\\\n    // 如果没有对话内容，直接返回 null\\\\n    if (messagesToUse.length === 0) {\\\\n      return null;\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 如果没有指定pageType，使用project-{projectId}格式\\\\n    const pageType = targetPageType || (projectId ? &amp;amp;#96;project-${projectId}&amp;amp;#96; : undefined);\\\\n\\\\n    setIsSummarizingConversation(true);\\\\n    try {\\\\n      // 构建对话文本\\\\n      const conversationText = messagesToUse.map((msg) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        const role = msg.sender === 'user' ? '用户' : 'AI助手';\\\\n        return &amp;amp;#96;${role}: ${msg.content}&amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n      }).join('\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n');\\\\n\\\\n      // 如果对话文本太长，先截断（保留前2000字符）\\\\n      const maxLength = 2000;\\\\n      const truncatedText = conversationText.length &amp;amp;gt; maxLength \\\\n        ? conversationText.substring(0, maxLength) + '\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n...（内容已截断）'\\\\n        : conversationText;\\\\n\\\\n      // 生成总结（简化版本：使用对话内容作为描述，标题为总结）\\\\n      // 如果对话很长，取前100字符作为标题\\\\n      let summaryTitle = '项目资源对话摘要';\\\\n      let summaryDescription = truncatedText;\\\\n\\\\n      // 尝试使用 AI 生成更智能的总结\\\\n;\\\\n;\\\",\""
                },

                  "lineNumber": 26140,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"        \\\"contents\\\": \\\"const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \\\\n\\\\n\\\\n  // 自动保存对话摘要（使用指定的消息列表）\\\\n  const autoSaveConversationSummaryWithMessages = async (messages: Array&amp;amp;lt;{ id: string; content: string; sender: 'user' | 'ai'; timestamp: Date }&amp;amp;gt;) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (!projectId) return;\\\\n    \\\\n    // 检查是否有至少一轮完整的问答（至少一条用户消息和一条AI消息）\\\\n    const userMessages = messages.filter(msg =&amp;amp;gt; msg.sender === 'user');\\\\n    const aiResponseMessages = messages.filter(msg =&amp;amp;gt; msg.sender === 'ai');\\\\n    \\\\n    // 如果没有完整的对话，不保存\\\\n    if (userMessages.length === 0 || aiResponseMessages.length === 0) {\\\\n      return;\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 如果有已保存的对话来源ID，先尝试删除旧的（如果存在）\\\\n    // 然后保存新的对话摘要\\\\n    try {\\\\n      // 如果已经有保存的对话，更新它；否则创建新的\\\\n      if (savedConversationSourceId) {\\\\n        // 尝试删除旧的来源记录（使用数据库ID）\\\\n        try {\\\\n          const idNumber = parseInt(savedConversationSourceId);\\\\n          if (!isNaN(idNumber)) {\\\\n            await api.delete(&amp;amp;#96;/source-information/${idNumber}&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n          }\\\\n        } catch (error) {\\\\n          console.warn('删除旧对话记录失败:', error);\\\\n          // 如果删除失败，继续创建新的\\\\n        }\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      // 保存新的对话摘要，使用 project-${projectId} 作为 pageType，传入消息列表\\\\n      const savedId = await summarizeAndSaveConversation(undefined, messages);\\\\n      \\\\n      if (savedId) {\\\\n        setSavedConversationSourceId(savedId);\\\\n        \\\\n        // 刷新历史记录\\\\n        await loadSources(); // 重新加载来源列表\\\\n        // 更新历史记录列表，但不自动切换视图（避免强制跳回历史记录页面）\\\\n        await checkHistoryRecords(false); // 传入 false 表示不自动切换视图\\\\n        \\\\n        console.log('[ProjectResources] 对话摘要已自动保存:', savedId);\\\\n      }\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('[ProjectResources] 自动保存对话摘要失败:', error);\\\\n      // 不抛出错误，避免影响用户体验\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  const loadPublicKnowledgeFiles = async () =&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n;\\\\n;\\\",\""
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 26148,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"        \\\"contents\\\": \\\"const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \\\\nconst summarizeAndSaveConversation = async \\\\n\\\\n      const source: Source = {\\\\n        id: sourceId,\\\\n        title: summaryTitle,\\\\n        type: 'external',\\\\n        description: summaryDescription,\\\\n        category: 'ai-qa-summary', // AI问答总结信息\\\\n      };\\\\n\\\\n      // 保存到数据库\\\\n      const saveResult = await sourceService.saveSourceInformation(\\\\n        source,\\\\n        pageType,\\\\n        aiConversationId || undefined\\\\n      );\\\\n\\\\n      if (saveResult.success &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; saveResult.data) {\\\\n        console.log('[ProjectResources] 对话摘要已保存:', {\\\\n          id: saveResult.data.id,\\\\n          sourceId: saveResult.data.source_id,\\\\n          title: saveResult.data.title,\\\\n          pageType: pageType\\\\n        });\\\\n        // 返回数据库的 id（数字），用于后续删除操作\\\\n        return saveResult.data.id?.toString() || null;\\\\n      } else {\\\\n        console.error('[ProjectResources] 保存对话摘要失败:', saveResult.error);\\\\n        return null;\\\\n      }\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('[ProjectResources] 总结对话失败:', error);\\\\n      return null;\\\\n    } finally {\\\\n      setIsSummarizingConversation(false);\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  // 保存技术转译内容为来源信息\\\\n  const saveTechnicalTranslationAsSource = async (targetPageType: 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-package')\\\\n;\\\\n;\\\",\""
                },
                {

                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"        \\\"contents\\\": \\\"const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \\\\nconst summarizeAndSaveConversation = async \\\\n\\\\n\\\\n      // 尝试使用 AI 生成更智能的总结\\\\n      try {\\\\n        const aiQAConfig = await configService.getDifyConfig('smart-workflow-ai-qa');\\\\n        const summaryPrompt = &amp;amp;#96;请对以下对话进行总结，生成一个简洁的标题（不超过30字）和一段摘要（不超过300字）。用中文回答，格式为：\\\\n标题：[标题]\\\\n摘要：[摘要内容]\\\\n\\\\n对话内容：\\\\n${truncatedText}&amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n\\\\n        const result = await workflowAPI.aiSearch(\\\\n          summaryPrompt,\\\\n          { context: [{ role: 'user', content: summaryPrompt }] },\\\\n          (aiQAConfig &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; aiQAConfig.enabled) ? 0) {\\\\n        inputs.projectResources = resourceContext.join('\\\\\\\\n');\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      // 调用AI问答API\\\\n      const result = await workflowAPI.aiSearch(\\\\n        currentMessage,\\\\n        inputs,\\\\n        (aiQAConfig &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; {\\\\n        const updated = [...prev, aiMessage];\\\\n        // 在状态更新后，使用最新的消息列表自动保存\\\\n        setTimeout(async () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n          await autoSaveConversationSummaryWithMessages(updated);\\\\n        }, 300);\\\\n        return updated;\\\\n      });\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('AI问答API调用失败:', error);\\\\n      const errorMessage = {\\\\n        id: (Date.now() + 1).toString(),\\\\n        content: '抱歉，AI服务暂时不可用，请稍后重试。',\\\\n        sender: 'ai' as const,\\\\n        timestamp: new Date(),\\\\n      };\\\\n      setAiMessages((prev) =&amp;amp;gt;                   "content": "        \"contents\": \"const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \\n\\n\\n  // 自动保存对话摘要（使用指定的消息列表）\\n  const autoSaveConversationSummaryWithMessages = async (messages: Array&amp;lt;{ id: string; content: string; sender: 'user' | 'ai'; timestamp: Date }&amp;gt;) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (!projectId) return;\\n    \\n    // 检查是否有至少一轮完整的问答（至少一条用户消息和一条AI消息）\\n    const userMessages = messages.filter(msg =&amp;gt; msg.sender === 'user');\\n    const aiResponseMessages = messages.filter(msg =&amp;gt; msg.sender === 'ai');\\n    \\n    // 如果没有完整的对话，不保存\\n    if (userMessages.length === 0 || aiResponseMessages.length === 0) {\\n      return;\\n    }\\n\\n    // 如果有已保存的对话来源ID，先尝试删除旧的（如果存在）\\n    // 然后保存新的对话摘要\\n    try {\\n      // 如果已经有保存的对话，更新它；否则创建新的\\n      if (savedConversationSourceId) {\\n        // 尝试删除旧的来源记录（使用数据库ID）\\n        try {\\n          const idNumber = parseInt(savedConversationSourceId);\\n          if (!isNaN(idNumber)) {\\n            await api.delete(&amp;#96;/source-information/${idNumber}&amp;#96;);\\n          }\\n        } catch (error) {\\n          console.warn('删除旧对话记录失败:', error);\\n          // 如果删除失败，继续创建新的\\n        }\\n      }\\n\\n      // 保存新的对话摘要，使用 project-${projectId} 作为 pageType，传入消息列表\\n      const savedId = await summarizeAndSaveConversation(undefined, messages);\\n      \\n      if (savedId) {\\n        setSavedConversationSourceId(savedId);\\n        \\n        // 刷新历史记录\\n        await loadSources(); // 重新加载来源列表\\n        // 更新历史记录列表，但不自动切换视图（避免强制跳回历史记录页面）\\n        await checkHistoryRecords(false); // 传入 false 表示不自动切换视图\\n        \\n        console.log('[ProjectResources] 对话摘要已自动保存:', savedId);\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('[ProjectResources] 自动保存对话摘要失败:', error);\\n      // 不抛出错误，避免影响用户体验\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const loadPublicKnowledgeFiles = async () =&amp;gt;\\n;\\n;\","

0) {\\\\n        inputs.projectResources = resourceContext.join('\\\\\\\\n');\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      // 调用AI问答API\\\\n      const result = await workflowAPI.aiSearch(\\\\n        currentMessage,\\\\n        inputs,\\\\n        (aiQAConfig &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; {\\\\n        const updated = [...prev, aiMessage];\\\\n        // 在状态更新后，使用最新的消息列表自动保存\\\\n        setTimeout(async () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n          await autoSaveConversationSummaryWithMessages(updated);\\\\n        }, 300);\\\\n        return updated;\\\\n      });\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('AI问答API调用失败:', error);\\\\n      const errorMessage = {\\\\n        id: (Date.now() + 1).toString(),\\\\n        content: '抱歉，AI服务暂时不可用，请稍后重试。',\\\\n        sender: 'ai' as const,\\\\n        timestamp: new Date(),\\\\n      };\\\\n      setAiMessages((prev) =&amp;amp;gt; msg.sender === 'user');\\\\n    const aiResponseMessages = messages.filter(msg =&amp;amp;gt; msg.sender === 'ai');\\\\n    \\\\n    // 如果没有完整的对话，不保存\\\\n    if (userMessages.length === 0 || aiResponseMessages.length === 0) {\\\\n      return;\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 如果有已保存的对话来源ID，先尝试删除旧的（如果存在）\\\\n    // 然后保存新的对话摘要\\\\n    try {\\\\n      // 如果已经有保存的对话，更新它；否则创建新的\\\\n      if (savedConversationSourceId) {\\\\n        // 尝试删除旧的来源记录（使用数据库ID）\\\\n        try {\\\\n          const idNumber = parseInt(savedConversationSourceId);\\\\n          if (!isNaN(idNumber)) {\\\\n            await api.delete(&amp;amp;#96;/source-information/${idNumber}&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n          }\\\\n        } catch (error) {\\\\n          console.warn('删除旧对话记录失败:', error);\\\\n          // 如果删除失败，继续创建新的\\\\n        }\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      // 保存新的对话摘要，使用 project-${projectId} 作为 pageType，传入消息列表\\\\n      const savedId = await summarizeAndSaveConversation(undefined, messages);\\\\n      \\\\n      if (savedId) {\\\\n        setSavedConversationSourceId(savedId);\\\\n        \\\\n        // 刷新历史记录\\\\n        await loadSources();                   "content": "        \"contents\": \"const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \\n() =&amp;gt; {\\n\\n    \\n    const internetInfo = sources.filter(s =&amp;gt; {\\n      // 排除上传的文件（URL是文件路径的）\\n      const hasUrl = s.url &amp;amp;&amp;amp; typeof s.url === 'string' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; s.url.trim().length &amp;gt; 0;\\n      if (!hasUrl) {\\n        // 没有URL的文本来源，需要检查是否是对话摘要或技术转译\\n        const category = getCategory(s);\\n        if (category === 'ai-qa-summary' || category === 'technical-translation') {\\n          return false; // 排除对话摘要和技术转译\\n        }\\n        return true; // 没有URL且不是对话摘要/技术转译的，归类为互联网信息\\n      }\\n      \\n      const urlStr = s.url.trim();\\n      const isHttpUrl = urlStr.startsWith('http://') || urlStr.startsWith('https://');\\n      const isFileUrl = !isHttpUrl &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n        urlStr.startsWith('/uploads/') || \\n        urlStr.startsWith('uploads/') ||\\n        /\\\\.(pdf|doc|docx|txt|md|jpg|jpeg|png|gif|webp|ppt|pptx)$/i.test(urlStr)\\n      );\\n      \\n      if (isFileUrl) {\\n        return false; // 排除文件\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 排除对话摘要和技术转译（这些应该显示在历史记录中，而不是互联网信息点）\\n      const category = getCategory(s);\\n      if (category === 'ai-qa-summary' || category === 'technical-translation') {\\n        return false; // 排除对话摘要和技术转译\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 包含http/https链接的来源，或者没有URL的文本来源（通过检索信息添加的）\\n      return true;\\n    });\\n    \\n    // 将公共知识库文件（type: 'knowledge_base'）转换为知识点格式\\n    const publicKnowledgeSources = sources.filter(s =&amp;gt; s.type === 'knowledge_base');\\n    const publicKnowledgeAsPoints: KnowledgePoint[] = publicKnowledgeSources.map(source =&amp;gt; ({\\n      id: source.id,\\n      tech_point_id: 0,\\n);\\n  }\\n;\","

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \\n\\n\\n  // 提炼为技术点\\n  const handleExtractTechPoint = async (record: SourceInformation) =&amp;gt; {\\n    setExtractingTechPoint(true);\\n    setExtractingSourceId(record.id);\\n    \\n    try {\\n      // 获取对话内容\\n      const conversationContent = record.description || record.title || '';\\n      \\n      // 构建AI提示词，要求提取技术点信息并转换为JSON格式\\n      const extractPrompt = &amp;#96;你是一个技术信息提取专家。请分析以下对话内容，提炼关键信息并转换为技术点的标准JSON格式。\\n\\n对话内容：\\n${conversationContent}\\n\\n请提取以下关键信息并生成JSON：\\n\\n必需字段：\\n1. name: 技术名称（简短、准确，不超过50字）\\n2. description: 技术描述（1-2句话概括，不超过200字）\\n3. tech_type: 技术类型（必须是：feature、improvement、innovation、technology 之一）\\n4. priority: 优先级（必须是：low、medium、high 之一）\\n5. technical_details: 技术细节（JSON对象，可以包含：tech_principle技术原理、tech_value技术价值、tech_boundary技术边界等）\\n6. benefits: 技术优势（字符串数组，列出3-5个关键优势，每个不超过100字）\\n7. applications: 应用场景（字符串数组，列出应用场景，每个不超过100字）\\n8. keywords: 关键词（字符串数组，提取3-8个关键词）\\n9. features: 特性说明（字符串，格式化的markdown，包含：\\n   - 【一句话说明（slogan）】\\n   - 【技术品牌定位与愿景】\\n   - 【用户体验与场景】\\n   如果信息不足，可以使用\\\"敬请期待\\\"作为占位符）\\n\\n输出要求：\\n- 只返回JSON格式，不要包含任何markdown代码块标记或其他文字说明\\n- JSON必须是有效的，可以直接用JSON.parse()解析\\n- 如果某些信息无法从对话中提取，使用合理的默认值或空值\\n- 所有数组字段必须是数组格式，即使为空也要使用[]\\n- technical_details必须是对象格式，即使为空也要使用{}\\n\\n示例JSON格式：\\n{\\n  \\\"name\\\": \\\"技术名称\\\",\\n  \\\"description\\\": \\\"技术描述\\\",\\n  \\\"tech_type\\\": \\\"feature\\\",\\n  \\\"priority\\\": \\\"medium\\\",\\n  \\\"technical_details\\\": {\\n    \\\"tech_principle\\\": \\\"技术原理说明\\\",\\n    \\\"tech_value\\\": \\\"技术价值说明\\\",\\n    \\\"tech_boundary\\\": \\\"技术边界说明\\\"\\n  },\\n  \\\"benefits\\\": [\\\"优势1\\\", \\\"优势2\\\", \\\"优势3\\\"],\\n  \\\"applications\\\": [\\\"场景1\\\", \\\"场景2\\\"],\\n  \\\"keywords\\\": [\\\"关键词1\\\", \\\"关键词2\\\", \\\"关键词3\\\"],\\n  \\\"features\\\": \\\"【一句话说明（slogan）】\\\\\\\\n说明内容\\\\\\\\n【技术品牌定位与愿景】\\\\\\\\n定位：定位说明\\\\\\\\n愿景：愿景说明\\\\\\\\n【用户体验与场景】\\\\\\\\n场景说明\\\"\\n}\\n\\n现在请分析对话内容并返回JSON：&amp;#96;;\\n;\\n;\","

                  "lineNumber": 62356,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \\nconst handleAISendMessage = async \\n\\n    setAiLoading(true);\\n\\n    try {\\n      // 获取智能工作流AI问答的Dify配置\\n      const aiQAConfig = await configService.getDifyConfig('smart-workflow-ai-qa');\\n\\n      // 构建上下文信息（包含项目资源）\\n      const contextMessages = aiMessages.map((msg) =&amp;gt; ({\\n        role: msg.sender === 'user' ? 'user' : 'assistant',\\n        content: msg.content,\\n      }));\\n\\n      // 添加项目资源信息到上下文\\n      const resourceContext: string[] = [];\\n      if (configuredResources.techPoints.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        resourceContext.push(&amp;#96;已选择的技术点：${configuredResources.techPoints.map(tp =&amp;gt; tp.name).join('、')}&amp;#96;);\\n      }\\n      if (configuredResources.files.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        resourceContext.push(&amp;#96;已上传的文件：${configuredResources.files.map(f =&amp;gt; f.title).join('、')}&amp;#96;);\\n      }\\n      if (configuredResources.knowledgePoints.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        resourceContext.push(&amp;#96;已选择的知识点：${configuredResources.knowledgePoints.map(kp =&amp;gt; kp.title).join('、')}&amp;#96;);\\n      }\\n\\n      const inputs: any = {\\n        context: contextMessages,\\n      };\\n\\n      if (resourceContext.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        inputs.projectResources = resourceContext.join('\\\\n');\\n      }\\n\\n      // 调用AI问答API\\n      const result = await workflowAPI.aiSearch(\\n        currentMessage,\\n        inputs,\\n        (aiQAConfig &amp;amp;&amp;amp; aiQAConfig.enabled) ? aiQAConfig : undefined,\\n        aiConversationId || undefined\\n      );\\n\\n      let responseContent = '抱歉，我无法处理您的请求。';\\n\\n      if (result.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; result.data) {\\n        responseContent = result.data.answer || result.data.result || responseContent;\\n        // 更新conversationId以支持多轮对话\\n        if (result.data.conversation_id) {\\n          setAiConversationId(result.data.conversation_id);\\n        }\\n      } else {\\n        responseContent = result.error || responseContent;\\n      }\\n\\n      const aiMessage = {\\n        id: (Date.now() + 1).toString(),\\n,\\n      };\\n;\\n;\","

(typeof s.url === 'string' || typeof s.url === 'object');\\n      if (!hasUrl) {\\n        console.log('[资源清单] ✗ 未识别为文件（无URL）:', { \\n          id: s.id, \\n          title: s.title, \\n          type: s.type,\\n          url: s.url,\\n          urlType: typeof s.url\\n        });\\n        return false;\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 处理URL（可能是字符串或对象）\\n      let urlStr: string;\\n      if (typeof s.url === 'string') {\\n        urlStr = s.url.trim();\\n      } else if (s.url &amp;amp;&amp;amp; typeof s.url === 'object' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; 'toString' in s.url) {\\n        urlStr = String(s.url).trim();\\n      } else {\\n        console.log('[资源清单] ✗ 未识别为文件（URL格式异常）:', { \\n          id: s.id, \\n          title: s.title, \\n          type: s.type,\\n          url: s.url,\\n          urlType: typeof s.url\\n        });\\n        return false;\\n      }\\n      \\n      if (urlStr.length === 0) {\\n        return false;\\n      }\\n    };\\n  }\\n;\","

                  "lineNumber": 596,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \\n() =&amp;gt; {\\n\\n    \\n    const internetInfo = sources.filter(s =&amp;gt; {\\n      // 排除上传的文件（URL是文件路径的）\\n      const hasUrl = s.url &amp;amp;&amp;amp; typeof s.url === 'string' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; s.url.trim().length &amp;gt; 0;\\n      if (!hasUrl) {\\n        // 没有URL的文本来源，需要检查是否是对话摘要或技术转译\\n        const category = getCategory(s);\\n        if (category === 'ai-qa-summary' || category === 'technical-translation') {\\n          return false; // 排除对话摘要和技术转译\\n        }\\n        return true; // 没有URL且不是对话摘要/技术转译的，归类为互联网信息\\n      }\\n      \\n      const urlStr = s.url.trim();\\n      const isHttpUrl = urlStr.startsWith('http://') || urlStr.startsWith('https://');\\n      const isFileUrl = !isHttpUrl &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n        urlStr.startsWith('/uploads/') || \\n        urlStr.startsWith('uploads/') ||\\n        /\\\\.(pdf|doc|docx|txt|md|jpg|jpeg|png|gif|webp|ppt|pptx)$/i.test(urlStr)\\n      );\\n      \\n      if (isFileUrl) {\\n        return false; // 排除文件\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 排除对话摘要和技术转译（这些应该显示在历史记录中，而不是互联网信息点）\\n      const category = getCategory(s);\\n      if (category === 'ai-qa-summary' || category === 'technical-translation') {\\n        return false; // 排除对话摘要和技术转译\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 包含http/https链接的来源，或者没有URL的文本来源（通过检索信息添加的）\\n      return true;\\n    });\\n    \\n    // 将公共知识库文件（type: 'knowledge_base'）转换为知识点格式\\n    const publicKnowledgeSources = sources.filter(s =&amp;gt; s.type === 'knowledge_base');\\n    const publicKnowledgeAsPoints: KnowledgePoint[] = publicKnowledgeSources.map(source =&amp;gt; ({\\n      id: source.id,\\n      tech_point_id: 0,\\n);\\n  }\\n;\","

                  "lineNumber": 6994,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \\n\\n\\n  // 总结对话内容并保存为来源信息\\n  const summarizeAndSaveConversation = async (targetPageType?: string, messages?: Array&amp;lt;{ id: string; content: string; sender: 'user' | 'ai'; timestamp: Date }&amp;gt;): Promise&amp;lt;string | null&amp;gt; =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 使用传入的消息列表，如果没有则使用状态中的消息\\n    const messagesToUse = messages || aiMessages;\\n    \\n    // 如果没有对话内容，直接返回 null\\n    if (messagesToUse.length === 0) {\\n      return null;\\n    }\\n\\n    // 如果没有指定pageType，使用project-{projectId}格式\\n    const pageType = targetPageType || (projectId ? &amp;#96;project-${projectId}&amp;#96; : undefined);\\n\\n    setIsSummarizingConversation(true);\\n    try {\\n      // 构建对话文本\\n      const conversationText = messagesToUse.map((msg) =&amp;gt; {\\n        const role = msg.sender === 'user' ?                   "content": "        \"contents\": \"const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \\nconst summarizeAndSaveConversation = async \\n\\n\\n      // 尝试使用 AI 生成更智能的总结\\n      try {\\n        const aiQAConfig = await configService.getDifyConfig('smart-workflow-ai-qa');\\n        const summaryPrompt = &amp;#96;请对以下对话进行总结，生成一个简洁的标题（不超过30字）和一段摘要（不超过300字）。用中文回答，格式为：\\n标题：[标题]\\n摘要：[摘要内容]\\n\\n对话内容：\\n${truncatedText}&amp;#96;;\\n\\n        const result = await workflowAPI.aiSearch(\\n          summaryPrompt,\\n          { context: [{ role: 'user', content: summaryPrompt }] },\\n          (aiQAConfig &amp;amp;&amp;amp; aiQAConfig.enabled) ? aiQAConfig : undefined,\\n          undefined\\n        );\\n\\n        if (result.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; result.data) {\\n          const aiResponse = result.data.answer || result.data.result || '';\\n          // 解析 AI 响应，提取标题和摘要\\n          const titleMatch = aiResponse.match(/标题[：:]\\\\s*(.+)/);\\n          const summaryMatch = aiResponse.match(/摘要[：:]\\\\s*(.+?)(?:\\\\n|$)/s);\\n          \\n          if (titleMatch &amp;amp;&amp;amp; titleMatch[1]) {\\n            summaryTitle = titleMatch[1].trim();\\n          }\\n          if (summaryMatch &amp;amp;&amp;amp; summaryMatch[1]) {\\n            summaryDescription = summaryMatch[1].trim();\\n            // 如果 AI 生成的摘要太短，补充完整对话内容\\n            if (summaryDescription.length &amp;lt; 200) {\\n              summaryDescription = &amp;#96;${summaryDescription}\\\\n\\\\n完整对话内容：\\\\n${truncatedText}&amp;#96;;\\n            }\\n          }\\n        }\\n      } catch (error) {\\n        console.warn('使用 AI 生成总结失败，使用简化版本:', error);\\n        // 如果 AI 调用失败，使用简化版本\\n        summaryTitle = messagesToUse.length &amp;gt; 0 \\n          ? &amp;#96;项目对话摘要（${messagesToUse.length}条消息）&amp;#96;\\n          : '项目对话摘要';\\n      }\\n\\n      // 创建来源信息\\n      const sourceId = &amp;#96;project_conversation_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}&amp;#96;;\\n      const source: Source = {\\n        id: sourceId,\\n        title: summaryTitle\\n      };\\n;\\n;\","

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \\n() =&amp;gt; {\\n\\n    \\n    const internetInfo = sources.filter(s =&amp;gt; {\\n      // 排除上传的文件（URL是文件路径的）\\n      const hasUrl = s.url &amp;amp;&amp;amp; typeof s.url === 'string' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; s.url.trim().length &amp;gt; 0;\\n      if (!hasUrl) {\\n        // 没有URL的文本来源，需要检查是否是对话摘要或技术转译\\n        const category = getCategory(s);\\n        if (category === 'ai-qa-summary' || category === 'technical-translation') {\\n          return false; // 排除对话摘要和技术转译\\n        }\\n        return true; // 没有URL且不是对话摘要/技术转译的，归类为互联网信息\\n      }\\n      \\n      const urlStr = s.url.trim();\\n      const isHttpUrl = urlStr.startsWith('http://') || urlStr.startsWith('https://');\\n      const isFileUrl = !isHttpUrl &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n        urlStr.startsWith('/uploads/') || \\n        urlStr.startsWith('uploads/') ||\\n        /\\\\.(pdf|doc|docx|txt|md|jpg|jpeg|png|gif|webp|ppt|pptx)$/i.test(urlStr)\\n      );\\n      \\n      if (isFileUrl) {\\n        return false; // 排除文件\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 排除对话摘要和技术转译（这些应该显示在历史记录中，而不是互联网信息点）\\n      const category = getCategory(s);\\n      if (category === 'ai-qa-summary' || category === 'technical-translation') {\\n        return false; // 排除对话摘要和技术转译\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 包含http/https链接的来源，或者没有URL的文本来源（通过检索信息添加的）\\n      return true;\\n    });\\n    \\n    // 将公共知识库文件（type: 'knowledge_base'）转换为知识点格式\\n    const publicKnowledgeSources = sources.filter(s =&amp;gt; s.type === 'knowledge_base');\\n    const publicKnowledgeAsPoints: KnowledgePoint[] = publicKnowledgeSources.map(source =&amp;gt; ({\\n      id: source.id,\\n      tech_point_id: 0,\\n);\\n  }\\n;\","

                  "lineNumber": 3010,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \\n\\n\\n  // 提炼为技术点\\n  const handleExtractTechPoint = async (record: SourceInformation) =&amp;gt; {\\n    setExtractingTechPoint(true);\\n    setExtractingSourceId(record.id);\\n    \\n    try {\\n      // 获取对话内容\\n      const conversationContent = record.description || record.title || '';\\n      \\n      // 构建AI提示词，要求提取技术点信息并转换为JSON格式\\n      const extractPrompt = &amp;#96;你是一个技术信息提取专家。请分析以下对话内容，提炼关键信息并转换为技术点的标准JSON格式。\\n\\n对话内容：\\n${conversationContent}\\n\\n请提取以下关键信息并生成JSON：\\n\\n必需字段：\\n1. name: 技术名称（简短、准确，不超过50字）\\n2. description: 技术描述（1-2句话概括，不超过200字）\\n3. tech_type: 技术类型（必须是：feature、improvement、innovation、technology 之一）\\n4. priority: 优先级（必须是：low、medium、high 之一）\\n5. technical_details: 技术细节（JSON对象，可以包含：tech_principle技术原理、tech_value技术价值、tech_boundary技术边界等）\\n6. benefits: 技术优势（字符串数组，列出3-5个关键优势，每个不超过100字）\\n7. applications: 应用场景（字符串数组，列出应用场景，每个不超过100字）\\n8. keywords: 关键词（字符串数组，提取3-8个关键词）\\n9. features: 特性说明（字符串，格式化的markdown，包含：\\n   - 【一句话说明（slogan）】\\n   - 【技术品牌定位与愿景】\\n   - 【用户体验与场景】\\n   如果信息不足，可以使用\\\"敬请期待\\\"作为占位符）\\n\\n输出要求：\\n- 只返回JSON格式，不要包含任何markdown代码块标记或其他文字说明\\n- JSON必须是有效的，可以直接用JSON.parse()解析\\n- 如果某些信息无法从对话中提取，使用合理的默认值或空值\\n- 所有数组字段必须是数组格式，即使为空也要使用[]\\n- technical_details必须是对象格式，即使为空也要使用{}\\n\\n示例JSON格式：\\n{\\n  \\\"name\\\": \\\"技术名称\\\",\\n  \\\"description\\\": \\\"技术描述\\\",\\n  \\\"tech_type\\\": \\\"feature\\\",\\n  \\\"priority\\\": \\\"medium\\\",\\n  \\\"technical_details\\\": {\\n    \\\"tech_principle\\\": \\\"技术原理说明\\\",\\n    \\\"tech_value\\\": \\\"技术价值说明\\\",\\n    \\\"tech_boundary\\\": \\\"技术边界说明\\\"\\n  },\\n  \\\"benefits\\\": [\\\"优势1\\\", \\\"优势2\\\", \\\"优势3\\\"],\\n  \\\"applications\\\": [\\\"场景1\\\", \\\"场景2\\\"],\\n  \\\"keywords\\\": [\\\"关键词1\\\", \\\"关键词2\\\", \\\"关键词3\\\"],\\n  \\\"features\\\": \\\"【一句话说明（slogan）】\\\\\\\\n说明内容\\\\\\\\n【技术品牌定位与愿景】\\\\\\\\n定位：定位说明\\\\\\\\n愿景：愿景说明\\\\\\\\n【用户体验与场景】\\\\\\\\n场景说明\\\"\\n}\\n\\n现在请分析对话内容并返回JSON：&amp;#96;;\\n;\\n;\","

                  "lineNumber": 4900,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"# 项目资源页面Agent调用分析\\n\\n## 分析结果\\n\\n### 1. AI问答功能 ✅ **调用Agent**\\n\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/pages/ProjectResourcesPage.tsx&amp;#96;\\n**函数**: &amp;#96;handleAISendMessage()&amp;#96;\\n\\n**实现方式**:\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;typescript\\n// 调用AI问答API\\nconst result = await workflowAPI.aiSearch(\\n  currentMessage,\\n  inputs,\\n  (aiQAConfig &amp;amp;&amp;amp; aiQAConfig.enabled) ? aiQAConfig : undefined,\\n  aiConversationId || undefined\\n);\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n**调用链路**:\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\nhandleAISendMessage()\\n  ↓\\nworkflowAPI.aiSearch()\\n  ↓\\nPOST /api/v1/workflow/ai-search\\n  ↓\\n后端工作流执行 / Dify调用\\n  ↓\\nAgent执行\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n**特点**:\\n- ✅ 支持多轮对话（conversationId传递）\\n- ✅ 包含项目资源上下文（技术点、文件、知识点）\\n- ✅ 通过工作流API调用，最终会调用Agent\\n- ✅ 可以配置Dify配置（smart-workflow-ai-qa）\\n\\n**结论**: **是调用Agent的**\\n\\n---\\n\\n### 2. 技术转译功能 ❌ **不调用Agent**\\n\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/pages/ProjectResourcesPage.tsx&amp;#96;\\n**函数**: &amp;#96;handleTechnicalTranslation()&amp;#96;\\n\\n**实现方式**:\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;typescript\\nconst handleTechnicalTranslation = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n  // 只是简单地拼接项目资源为markdown格式\\n  const contentParts: string[] = [];\\n  \\n  // 1. 拼接已选择的技术点\\n  // 2. 拼接已上传的文件\\n  // 3. 拼接已选择的知识点\\n  // 4. 拼接互联网信息点\\n  \\n  const finalContent = contentParts.join('');\\n  setTranslatedContent(finalContent);\\n};\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n**功能说明**:\\n- 这是一个**纯前端的数据整理功能**\\n- 将项目资源（技术点、文件、知识点、互联网信息）整理成markdown格式\\n- **不涉及任何AI调用**\\n- 只是将已选择的资源内容格式化输出\\n\\n**调用链路**:\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\nhandleTechnicalTranslation()\\n  ↓\\n前端数据整理（拼接markdown）\\n  ↓\\n显示转译结果\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n**结论**: **不是调用Agent的**，只是数据整理功能\\n\\n---\\n\\n## 总结\\n\\n| 功能 | 是否调用Agent | 说明 |\\n|------|--------------|------|\\n| **AI问答** | ✅ 是 | 通过&amp;#96;workflowAPI.aiSearch()&amp;#96;调用，最终会执行Agent |\\n| **技术转译** | ❌ 否 | 纯前端数据整理，将项目资源格式化为markdown |\","

{\\\\n        const updated = [...prev, aiMessage];\\\\n        // 在状态更新后，使用最新的消息列表自动保存\\\\n        setTimeout(async () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n          await autoSaveConversationSummaryWithMessages(updated);\\\\n        }, 300);\\\\n        return updated;\\\\n      });\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('AI问答API调用失败:', error);\\\\n      const errorMessage = {\\\\n        id: (Date.now() + 1).toString(),\\\\n        content: '抱歉，AI服务暂时不可用，请稍后重试。',\\\\n        sender: 'ai' as const,\\\\n        timestamp: new Date(),\\\\n      };\\\\n      setAiMessages((prev) =&amp;amp;gt; msg.sender === 'user');\\\\n    const aiResponseMessages = messages.filter(msg =&amp;amp;gt; msg.sender === 'ai');\\\\n    \\\\n    // 如果没有完整的对话，不保存\\\\n    if (userMessages.length === 0 || aiResponseMessages.length === 0) {\\\\n      return;\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 如果有已保存的对话来源ID，先尝试删除旧的（如果存在）\\\\n    // 然后保存新的对话摘要\\\\n    try {\\\\n      // 如果已经有保存的对话，更新它；否则创建新的\\\\n      if (savedConversationSourceId) {\\\\n        // 尝试删除旧的来源记录（使用数据库ID）\\\\n        try {\\\\n          const idNumber = parseInt(savedConversationSourceId);\\\\n          if (!isNaN(idNumber)) {\\\\n            await api.delete(&amp;amp;#96;/source-information/${idNumber}&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n          }\\\\n        } catch (error) {\\\\n          console.warn('删除旧对话记录失败:', error);\\\\n          // 如果删除失败，继续创建新的\\\\n        }\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      // 保存新的对话摘要，使用 project-${projectId} 作为 pageType，传入消息列表\\\\n      const savedId = await summarizeAndSaveConversation(undefined, messages);\\\\n      \\\\n      if (savedId) {\\\\n        setSavedConversationSourceId(savedId);\\\\n        \\\\n        // 刷新历史记录\\\\n        await loadSources(); // 重新加载来源列表\\\\n        await checkHistoryRecords(); // 检查并更新历史记录视图\\\\n        \\\\n        console.log('[ProjectResources] 对话摘要已自动保存:', savedId);\\\\n      }\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('[ProjectResources] 自动保存对话摘要失败:', error);\\\\n      // 不抛出错误，避免影响用户体验\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  const loadPublicKnowledgeFiles = async () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.getFiles();\\\\n      if (response.success &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; response.data) {\\\\n        setPublicKnowledgeFiles(response.data);\\\\n      }\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('加载公共知识库文件失败:', error);\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  // 更新已配置的资源清单\\\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 区分文件来源和互联网信息点\\\\n    // 文件来源：通过文件上传功能上传的文件（URL是文件路径，不是http链接）\\\\n    // 互联网信息点：来自\\\\\\\"检索信息\\\\\\\"模块的来源（排除上传的文件，只包含http/https链接或没有URL的文本来源）\\\\n    const files = sources.filter(s =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      // 文件上传的通常URL是文件路径，不是http链接\\\\n      return s.type === 'external' &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; s.url &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; !s.url.startsWith('http') &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; !s.url.startsWith('https');\\\\n    });\\\\n    // 互联网信息点：排除上传的文件，只包含真正的互联网信息（http/https链接或文本来源）\\\\n    const internetInfo = sources.filter(s =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      // 排除上传的文件（URL是文件路径的）\\\\n      if (s.url &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; !s.url.startsWith('http') &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; !s.url.startsWith('https')) {\\\\n        return false;\\\\n      }\\\\n      // 包含http/https链接的来源，或者没有URL的文本来源（通过检索信息添加的）\\\\n      return true;\\\\n    });\\\\n    \\\\n    setConfiguredResources({\\\\n      files: files,\\\\n      internetInfo: internetInfo,\\\\n      techPoints: techPoints.filter(tp =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (!projectId) return;\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const response = await projectService.getProjectById(parseInt(projectId));\\\\n      if (response.success &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; response.data) {\\\\n        setProject(response.data);\\\\n      }\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('加载项目失败:', error);\\\\n    } finally {\\\\n      setLoading(false);\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  const loadSources = async () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (!projectId) return;\\\\n    try {\\\\n      // 获取项目的来源信息\\\\n      const response = await api.get('/source-information', {\\\\n        params: {\\\\n          pageType: &amp;amp;#96;project-${projectId}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n          page: 1,\\\\n          pageSize: 100\\\\n        }\\\\n      });\\\\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; response.data.data) {\\\\n        setSources(response.data.data);\\\\n      }\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('加载来源信息失败:', error);\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  // 检查历史记录（用于决定显示哪个视图）\\\\n  const checkHistoryRecords = async () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (!projectId) return;\\\\n    setCheckingHistory(true);\\\\n    try {\\\\n      // 获取项目的所有来源信息\\\\n      const response = await api.get('/source-information', {\\\\n        params: {\\\\n          pageType: &amp;amp;#96;project-${projectId}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n          page: 1,\\\\n          pageSize: 1000\\\\n        }\\\\n      });\\\\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; {\\\\n          // 从 metadata 中解析 category\\\\n          let category: string | undefined;\\\\n          if (source.metadata) {\\\\n            if (typeof source.metadata === 'string') {\\\\n              try {\\\\n                const parsed = JSON.parse(source.metadata);\\\\n                category = parsed.category || parsed.sourceCategory;\\\\n              } catch (e) {\\\\n                // 忽略解析错误\\\\n              }\\\\n            } else if (typeof source.metadata === 'object') {\\\\n              category = source.metadata.category || source.metadata.sourceCategory;\\\\n            }\\\\n          }\\\\n          // 也检查直接设置的 category\\\\n          if (source.category) {\\\\n            category = source.category;\\\\n          }\\\\n          return category &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;
